description: Prepares your launch, as the site's launch form does (the same checks, fees and rules): stores the picture and the coin's metadata and answers { mint, transaction, summary }, the transaction base64 for your wallet to sign (a pump.fun launch adds venue and transactions, the same one in a list). Sign it with your wallet without sending it and give it to submit_launch within the hour. The picture is imageUrl: an https address on a public host, fetched once, held to the site's picture rules (png, jpg, gif or webp, at most 4 MB). A coin with a prize names one: skin (an id from search_prizes), case, or basket (2 to 10 ids). With a dev buy your wallet's WBTC does not cover, it answers devSwap instead: sign its transaction and send it (send_transaction, or any Solana RPC), then prepare_launch again with devBuySats as given. pair: 'souvenir' makes the coin trade against $SOUVENIR instead of SOL, on Souvenir's own curve, while launch_options says souv.on; its first buy, if any, is firstBuySouv, raw $SOUVENIR from your wallet. On such a coin a first buy written in SOL is paid in $SOUVENIR: when your wallet lacks it, prepare_launch answers souvSwap instead. Sign its transaction, send it (send_transaction, or any Solana RPC) and wait until it is confirmed, then call prepare_launch again with the same arguments plus firstBuySouv set to souvSwap.target. If it answers souvSwap again with the same held, the swap is not in Souvenir's read yet: wait and ask again, and do not sign that one. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Launching through the API is not open yet." while it is not open to your wallet. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize (or shopper_sample for a coin that picks its own prizes); (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

bannerUrl.description: A banner for the top of its page, optional: https; png, jpg or webp, at most 3 MB, three times as wide as tall, at least 600 px wide.

basket.description: A basket of prizes instead: round 1 draws the first, each draw picks the next.

basketOdds.description: Each basket prize's chance in whole percents, in the basket's order (equal without).

charity.description: A charity coin: { address, name, url?, pledgeBps?, rounds?, ship?, variant? }, as the site's form sends it.

curator.description: A shopper instead: the id of a sample pick this wallet asked for (shopper_sample). The coin picks each round’s prize itself from the sample’s brief and price band; round 1’s prize is the sample’s. Send nothing else in it.

devBuyLamports.description: A dev buy on a BTC pump.fun launch, in lamports, while launch_options says pump.devBuy.on.

devBuySats.description: The devSwap's devSats, given back once its swap landed.

feeBps.description: The trading fee in basis points (meteora); on a BTC pump.fun launch, its creator fee, one of launch_options pump.feeLevels.

firstBuyLamports.description: A first buy in lamports (Souvenir's curve, or a SOL pump.fun launch).

firstBuySouv.description: A first buy on a coin paired with $SOUVENIR, in raw $SOUVENIR (6 decimals) from your wallet, at most launch_options souv.maxFirstBuySouv. With firstBuyLamports it is the target souvSwap answered, sent again.

holdHours.description: How long a coin must be held before it counts in a draw.

imageUrl.description: The coin's picture: an https address on a public host; png, jpg, gif or webp, at most 4 MB.

ladder.description: A prize ladder instead: 2 to 10 places in order, 1st first, each its own winner at every draw (each worth no more than the place above).

launchWindow.description: meteora: the fee starts at 50% and falls to the coin's over 60 seconds.

links.description: https links; without a website, the coin's Souvenir page.

pair.description: What the coin trades against: sol, or souvenir ($SOUVENIR) on Souvenir's own curve while launch_options says souv.on.

shareBps.description: The fee's share for the prize pot, in basis points (7500 by default on the site); 0 is a coin with no prize.

shield.description: The launch shield, on a BTC pump.fun launch while launch_options says pump.shield.on.

skin.description: The prize: an id from search_prizes, or a CS2 skin's market name.

tickets.description: How a holder's balance turns into draw tickets; without it, capped at 3% of the supply a wallet.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

venue.description: meteora: Souvenir's own curve (it needs feeBps). pump: pump.fun, while launch_options says venues.pump.

volatility.description: meteora: Meteora's dynamic fee on top of the base fee.

name: prepare_launch
title: Prepare a coin's launch
